name: regenerate
lore:
### Entry VII: On the Rites of Regrowth

**Regenerate** is no mere mending; it is the violent, beautiful acceleration of life itself. When shaping the Weave for this rite, the caster feels a thrumming warmth, akin to the frantic heartbeat of a nesting bird or the relentless push of sap in spring. It is a heavy, verdant pull—a demand for growth that brooks no refusal from the spirit.

Visually, the magic manifests as a shimmering, emerald mist that clings to the wounded. Beneath this veil, the grisly becomes miraculous: severed limbs sprout translucent buds of bone and gristle, knitting into flesh in a wet, rhythmic blur. It is the sound of an entire forest growing in a single heartbeat.

Legend attributes its discovery to **Saint Valerius the Maimed**. Left for dead in the Whispering Glade with his sword-arm lost, he supposedly touched the Heart-Root of the First Oak. He did not pray for peace, but for the strength to finish his vigil. The forest answered, weaving its ancient vitality into his marrow and birthing the first instance of this restorative art.
